title: Geller teleported from New York City to Ossining
place_text: New York City to Ossining, New York

tellings.quote: teleported. So, he was walking down the street in New York City 1973, I think.

plain: A researcher called Greg, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, tells a story about Uri Geller, a man who worked with the researcher Andrija Puharich. Greg says that around 1973, as he remembers it, Geller was walking down a street in New York City and was suddenly teleported to Puharich's home in Ossining, a town north of the city. He links the story to a Super 8 home movie Puharich shot of a screened porch, and if it were true it would mean a person was moved across miles in an instant.
